verdict.rationale: Kushki markets 'Kajita de pagos' as a customizable payment form and offers a JS library (kushki.js) for PCI-secure card capture inside the merchant's own site, including 3DS flows. It lists these separately from its redirect-based 'Botón de pagos', so embedded checkout is a distinct first-party option. The evidence is mostly product headlines rather than in-depth guides. Missing for 10: detailed docs on component customization (styling, fields, layout), evidence of native mobile app SDK embedding, independent or hands-on corroboration.
